_comment: The one list of changes that always need a human, whoever opened the PR and whatever any reviewer said.
The ops broker applies it on every sync (README, 'Code triggers'): a PR head that matches keeps its
human-review status pending, and an agent's PR gets a flag filed for you. paths are Python regexes
matched against every path a PR touches (a rename's old one too). kinds are matched against the
kind: lines of every YAML file it touches, before and after. repos limits a rule to those repos,
and a rule without repos holds everywhere. trusted: who may author a PR or its commits without that
alone needing you; the PR reviewer and the ops App review and sign off, they don't author code.
This file is itself a trigger: changing it needs your sign-off.

triggers.what: an agent's policy or merge gate
the PR reviewer (any change to it)
